QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: receiverRole
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Passive uses the receiver's existing output without configuring it: its NMEA, u-blox UBX or Septentrio SBF position output provides the ground station position, and its RTCM output can be forwarded to vehicles. Configured base sets up a supported receiver as an RTK base station.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Receiver role

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: forwardReceiverRtcm
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Makes a passive receiver that already outputs RTCM, such as a pre-configured base station, a correction source for vehicles.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Forward receiver RTCM

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: baseReceiverManufacturers
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Detect automatically identifies the receiver each time it connects, by listening to its output and sending read-only identification queries. Until then the settings of every supported receiver are shown.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Detect automatically identifies the receiver family on every connection: QGroundControl listens to the receiver's output and sends read-only identification queries at each supported baud rate, then configures the family it found. Until then the settings of every supported receiver are shown. Select a manufacturer to configure only that receiver family.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Receiver manufacturer

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: connectionType
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Serial connects a receiver on a local port. TCP connects a receiver's network port or a serial-to-TCP bridge. UDP listens for the output of a receiver QGroundControl does not configure.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Receiver connection

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: tcpHost
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Host name or address of the receiver or serial-to-TCP bridge.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Receiver host

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: tcpPort
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: TCP port of the receiver or serial-to-TCP bridge.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Receiver TCP port

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: udpPort
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Listens on this local port for the receiver's output. The first sender is used until it stops sending.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Receiver UDP port

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: autoConnect
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Connects the saved receiver at startup and reconnects it when the connection is lost or the receiver is plugged back in. Disconnect pauses this until you connect again.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Connect the saved receiver when QGroundControl starts, reconnect it with increasing delays when the connection is lost, and reconnect a serial receiver as soon as it is plugged back in. A configured base without a saved serial device connects to an RTK receiver detected on USB instead. Disconnect pauses automatic connection until you connect again. When off, receivers connect only when you select Connect, and a lost connection is reported. Automatic connections never save settings to receiver flash.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Connect automatically

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: gcsPositionSource
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Source of the ground station position. Best available uses the connected GNSS receiver, then this device, and switches when the preferred source loses its fix.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: GCS position source

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: serialDevice
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Explicitly selected receiver port. Leave it empty for a configured base to connect to an RTK receiver detected on USB; generic USB serial adapters are not automatically identified as GNSS receivers.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Serial device

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: serialBaudRate
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Serial rate for an explicitly selected receiver. Auto (0) lets configurable receivers detect the rate; passive input requires the rate already configured on the receiver.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Baud rate

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: surveyInAccuracyLimit
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Receiver-specific survey accuracy limit. Quectel applies this limit to individual observations, not to guaranteed final position accuracy.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Survey-In accuracy

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: surveyInMinObservationDuration
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Defines the minimum observation time for the position calculation. Quectel counts accepted 1 Hz observations; elapsed time can be longer.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Min observation time

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: receiverAveragingDuration
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: The receiver averages its position for up to this time. This is not accuracy-controlled survey-in and does not guarantee a position accuracy.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Maximum averaging time

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: useFixedBasePosition
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Specify the RTK base mode: accuracy-controlled survey-in, fixed position, or receiver-managed averaging without an accuracy guarantee.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Base mode

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: fixedBasePositionLatitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Defines the latitude of the fixed RTK base position.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Base Position Latitude

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: fixedBasePositionLongitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Defines the longitude of the fixed RTK base position.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Base Position Longitude

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: fixedBasePositionAltitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Defines the altitude of the fixed RTK base position.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Base Position Alt (WGS84)

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: fixedBasePositionAccuracy
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Defines the accuracy of the fixed RTK base position.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Base Position Accuracy

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: compactRtcmCorrections
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Uses about a third less correction bandwidth, for example on slow telemetry radios. Doppler is omitted and measurements use lower resolution.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Compact RTCM corrections (MSM4)
